issues.problem: api glossed 'ever'; kaḥ api means 'anyone' (api is the additive/indefinite particle). 'ever' is not in the Sanskrit (purā is 'formerly') and licenses the added Hindi 'कभी'.
'कभी' (ever) is an added word; the Sanskrit has purā (formerly) and ko'pi (anyone), nothing for 'ever'. English correctly has 'formerly no one'.

Labelled 'm. loc. pl.' but it agrees with saukhyeṣu, which is neuter (line d's sarveṣu is rightly 'n.'). The word sarveṣu occurs twice in the unit, so no machine patch is possible; the line-b entry should read 'n. loc. pl.'.
